NOTICE OF MEETING
The Austin Bergstrom International Airport Development Corporation, Board of
Directors, will convene at 3:00 p.m. on Thursday, October 28, 2010, in Council
Chambers at Austin City Hall, 301 W. Second Street, Austin, Texas
AGENDA
The Board of Directors may go into a closed session under Chapter 551 of the Texas
Government Code to receive advice from legal counsel to discuss personnel matters or
for other reasons permitted by law as specifically listed on this agenda.
